judge: The agent made a reasonable attempt at the audit but had several gaps and issues. It browsed Product Strategy, Shared Assets, and Archive folders in CloudDrive. It opened CloudDocs and viewed some documents. It launched CloudSheets and CloudSlides. However, the agent did not thoroughly review all documents in CloudDocs for last-edited status (only saw a partial list), did not scroll through all CloudSheets spreadsheets, and did not properly check CloudSlides for draft vs final status (the CloudSlides screenshot shows presentations but no draft/final status was explicitly checked). The agent starred some files (League Operations Master, Partner Brief, All Hands Storyline) but Q3 Planning Brief and Board Prep were already starred. The summary document was created in CloudDocs with the audit content visible in screenshots 26-31, though there were some editing issues (the 'clear' action partially corrupted the text, then undo was used). The final document appears to contain the summary content. The agent did not fully browse all CloudDocs documents (only saw the first few in list view), did not scroll through all CloudSheets, and the CloudSlides review was superficial. The summary was created but the document creation process had issues with the 'Start typing here.' placeholder text remaining.
